_comment: DO NOT EDIT — Pterodactyl egg for Golden IQ MUSIC Bot. Import this file via the Pterodactyl admin panel: Nests -> (choose a nest) -> Import Egg.
name: Golden IQ MUSIC Bot
author: info@goldeniq.email
description: Discord music bot based on MuseHeart-MusicBot. Supports YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, Last.fm, slash commands, interactive player and Lavalink v3/v4. The bot can auto-download Lavalink.jar and a JDK if RUN_LOCAL_LAVALINK is enabled.
startup: if [ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" = "1" ] && [ -d ".git" ]; then git pull --ff-only || echo 'git pull failed, continuing with current files'; fi; if [ -f requirements.txt ] && [ "${SKIP_PIP_ON_START}" != "1" ]; then python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --user -r requirements.txt; fi; python3 -u main.py

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Golden IQ MUSIC Bot — Pterodactyl install script
# Runs inside an Alpine container; targets /mnt/server which is the
# user's persistent volume.

set -e

apk update
apk add --no-cache git curl ca-certificates bash openjdk17-jre-headless

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    if [ ! -d .git ]; then
        echo "[install] Cloning ${GIT_ADDRESS} (branch=${BRANCH:-main})"
        if [ -z "$(ls -A . 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
            git clone --branch "${BRANCH:-main}" --single-branch "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
        else
            git clone --branch "${BRANCH:-main}" --single-branch "${GIT_ADDRESS}" /tmp/repo
            cp -rn /tmp/repo/. .
            rm -rf /tmp/repo
        fi
    else
        echo "[install] Repo already cloned, pulling latest"
        git pull --ff-only || true
    fi
fi

if [ ! -f main.py ]; then
    echo '[install] WARNING: main.py not found. Upload your bot source via SFTP/File Manager or set GIT_ADDRESS env var.'
fi

if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
    echo '[install] Installing Python dependencies'
    python3 -m pip install --upgrade --no-cache-dir pip wheel setuptools
    python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
fi

if [ ! -f .env ] && [ -f .example.env ]; then
    echo '[install] Copying .example.env -> .env (remember to set TOKEN)'
    cp .example.env .env
fi

echo '[install] Done.'

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: The bot token from the Discord Developer Portal. Required.

variables.name: Git Repository (optional)
variables.description: If set, the bot source is cloned from this URL on first install. Leave empty if you upload files manually.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to clone when GIT_ADDRESS is set.

variables.name: Auto Update on Start
variables.description: Set to 1 to run `git pull` on every start (only effective if the repo was cloned via GIT_ADDRESS).

variables.name: Skip pip install on start
variables.description: Set to 1 to skip `pip install -r requirements.txt` on every start (faster boot after first run).

variables.name: MongoDB Connection URL
variables.description: Optional. Recommended for production. Leave blank to fall back to the local JSON database.

variables.name: Default command prefix
variables.description: Prefix for legacy text commands.

variables.name: Owner IDs
variables.description: Space-separated Discord user IDs that should have owner privileges.

variables.name: Run Lavalink locally
variables.description: If true, the bot will download and run Lavalink.jar inside the container (requires Java, which the install script provides).

variables.name: Connect to local Lavalink
variables.description: If true the bot connects to the locally launched Lavalink instance after starting it.

variables.name: Auto-download Lavalink server list
variables.description: Fetch a public Lavalink server list if local Lavalink is disabled.

variables.name: Lavalink initial RAM (MB)
variables.description: JVM -Xms value for the local Lavalink instance.

variables.name: Lavalink RAM limit (MB)
variables.description: JVM -Xmx value for the local Lavalink instance.

variables.name: Last.fm API key
variables.description: Optional. Enables Last.fm scrobbling features.

variables.name: Last.fm API secret
variables.description: Optional. Required if LASTFM_KEY is set.

variables.name: Spotify Client ID
variables.description: Optional. Required for Spotify link playback if your Lavalink does not include LavaSrc.

variables.name: Spotify Client Secret
variables.description: Optional. Pairs with SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.

variables.name: Error report webhook (manual)
variables.description: Optional. A Discord webhook URL where users can manually report errors via a button.

variables.name: Error report webhook (auto)
variables.description: Optional. Webhook URL the bot will automatically post unhandled errors to.

variables.name: RPC web server port
variables.description: Port for the RPC/Rich-Presence web server (the bot exposes this via Pterodactyl's primary allocation).
